basic_info.description: Redesigned w impeccable taste & fully renovated in 2017, this luxurious 4BR, 4BA residence offers 3,055 sqft of thoughtfully curated living space in one of SF's most vibrant neighborhoods. The main level opens to a sunlit living room framed by double-hung windows & a classic wood-burning fireplace, flowing into an elegant dining area & a chef's kitchen. Two spacious BRs & 2 full BAs on this level offer comfort & flexibility for family living or guests. The kitchen is a culinary showpiece, featuring a waterfall quartz island, Wolf 6-burner range w/ dbl oven, & open shelving w/ LED accent lighting. The lower level offers great versatility w/ 2 additional sleeping areas & access to a large outdoor deck, including a grand ensuite BR paired w/ a generous den ideal for an office or nursery. A hall BA w/ roll-in shower, full laundry room, & interior access to the 1-2 car garage complete this level. Wide-plank oak floors, AC, & solar panels elevate comfort, efficiency & sustainability. Redwood decks on every level, a landscaped backyard & spectacular rooftop terrace complete this exceptional indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Located on a tree-lined street near Gus's Market, Flour + Water, Tartine Manufactory w quick access to Potrero Hill, Mission, Bernal Heights, public transit &  tech shuttles
